assignment-board.name: Assignment Board
assignment-board.description: Build a board from their assignment sheet, employee list, and calendar. They dispatch. You list holes.

credential-expirations.name: Credential Expirations
credential-expirations.description: List credential types with expiration or issued dates on or before the pack date, plus blank dates they track.

do-not-send-list.name: Do Not Send List
do-not-send-list.description: Print people flagged DNS or DNR with the scope they coded. They own the flags.

fill-vs-open.name: Fill Vs Open
fill-vs-open.description: Join job orders to assignments. Count filled versus open with their status words and fill-rate formula.

holiday-shift-list.name: Holiday Shift List
holiday-shift-list.description: List who is scheduled on a holiday they wrote, quoting premiums only from the rate file.

incident-routing.name: Incident Routing
incident-routing.description: List incident form-present, date, site, and named receiver. They investigate. You flag missing forms.

open-job-orders.name: Open Job Orders
open-job-orders.description: List orders they still code as open or partial-fill. They fill. You do not invent or close orders.

orientation-missing.name: Orientation Missing
orientation-missing.description: List missing orientation sign-ins and acks against people who should have a packet.

timesheet-completeness.name: Timesheet Completeness
timesheet-completeness.description: List missing timesheet files, punches, blank totals, and missing approval ticks for the named period.
